# Warlock — Affliction

## Talent Prototype

Two normal talent tiers plus one capstone. Canonical Classic identities/icons come from the Affliction tree. Unlocks use only structured tier thresholds; there are no per-node prerequisite chains.

tier_1.name: Suppression
tier_1.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

tier_2.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.
